creators.name: Gilles Pudlowski
creators.platform: blog (Les Pieds dans le Plat, gillespudlowski.com)
creators.credible: One of France's most prominent gastronomic critics — decades at Le Point, former Gault&Millau, author of many food guides, born in Metz. Large, long-standing readership and a searchable blog. Findable place-naming pieces used here: 'Metz : les délices sucrés de Bourguignon' (Pâtisserie Claude Bourguignon) and 'Chez Mauricette, épicerie Metz — les bons casse-croûte de Mauricette' (Chez Mauricette, Marché Couvert de Metz).
